title: Period-End Reconciliation and Flux - DemoCo Exchange Account, Q2 2026
conclusionSummary: The exchange account reconciles at 2026-06-30: the 2,650.00 USD difference between the statement (1,250,000.00) and the ledger (1,247,350.00) is a 3,000.00 deposit in transit and a 350.00 trading fee the ledger had not recorded; the fee is booked, the deposit clears itself. The quarter's flux explains the one variance above threshold (digital assets, +42%) with the ETH purchase.
